description: This file is a shell script (.sh) used for testing notes merging functionality in a git repository. It contains setup functions, verification routines, and a series of test cases for different merge strategies and scenarios specific to git notes.

methods.name: verify_notes
methods.description: Verifies the notes for a specific reference and commit, comparing against expected output files.

methods.name: verify_fanout
methods.description: Checks that the notes tree for a given reference has a fanout structure (fanout level == 1).

methods.name: verify_no_fanout
methods.description: Checks that the notes tree for a given reference has no fanout (fanout level == 0).
